description: estate-ci#261 (STD-OPS-02, DR-51): the repositories the estate version detector covers. renovate.yml runs one Renovate pass per repository whose batch is in active_batches, each with its own one-repository vallery-pin-bot token. Every integer batch must be in active_batches (renovate-repos.py check). A repository joins by getting its own renovate.json (until then Renovate skips it: requireConfig=required), being covered by the vallery-pin-bot installation (renovate.yml mode=probe), and being listed in an active batch. batch "exception" marks an entry that cannot be scanned yet; its note names what is missing and the issue that moves it into a batch. Every active (non-archived) owner repository appears exactly once.
